itemList.description:
Design, Manfacture and suppy of "Stationery desilting machine for removing silt in seweage receving chamber with the following technical specification: SEES-3500-SC, Rated lifting moment : 15 meters, Rated lifting capacity : 300 kgs at 2.2m, Max Outer each : 3.5m, Max lines of hook : 1, Slweing angle : 180 Degree, Boom raising angle : 45 Degree, Max, Lifting height ( the measurment from the ground after the out rigger fully extended : 4765 mm, lenght of the basic boom : 2m, lenght of fully extended boom: 3.5, Boom section :2, Rope Diamtere : 16mm
 Grabber volume : 40.80 ltrs, Opertaing pressure : 140 BAR, Recommended oil tanker capacity : 100 L, Rope total lenght : 20 Mtrs, Torsional moment (dynamic): 3.4 KNM 0.90 mt, Safety / devices : To be provided with the following - Pressure relief valve for hydraulic circuit, Counter balance valve for boom rising and boom telescoping cyclinder, Pilot operated valves for verticals outrigger cyclinder, Boom angle indicator with load induicator, Hook safety latch, Automatic & mechanical brake for winch, load meter, Automatic stop for over winding, level indicator, Emergency stop button
Erection and commissioning of the above equipments by providing necessary civil works, labour, materials if any to complete the scope of work
